# A Withered Reach Epic

*Now and then the Reach throws up something far worse than an Elite. Tavi pays well for every Epic brought down.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md) |
| Level | 55 |
| After | [The Greywater](../quests/ennek_the_greywater.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 1 Epic Epic of the Withered Reach ([Swollen Stump](../monsters/swollen_stump.md), [Raider Boar](../monsters/raider_boar.md), [Swollen Dark Stump](../monsters/swollen_dark_stump.md), [War Mask](../monsters/war_mask.md), [Bone Hound](../monsters/bone_hound.md), [Swollen Axe Stump](../monsters/swollen_axe_stump.md), [Stone Hulk](../monsters/stone_hulk.md))

## Rewards

- 34,500 EXP
- 1,100 mesos
- +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 34,500 EXP, 2,500 mesos, [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x2, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md)
